title: More Trophies and Recipes
description:
A datapack for 25w14craftmine

Adds new items and trophies for you to get

New Trophies, Recipes and Rooms will be added
body:
## The project is on halt for the moment 
### (But if this gets to 50 downloads the project is still ongoing)
A Datapack for snapshot 25w14craftmine for anyone that wants more challenge for rewards

This Datapack adds
Warden Trophy
TNT Trophy
Copper Pickaxe
Better Diamond Armor
Emerald Pickaxe
New Shimmering Key Rooms

Items that can be transferred from a mine to the Hub
Warden Trophy
TNT Trophy
Item Frame
Glow Item Frame
Player Heads
Shimmering Keys

More Recipes/Trophies will be added

Notice!
This datapack is only for snapshot 25w14craftmine
